# Markup

Plain text with **bold**, *italic*, <u>underline</u> and ~~strike~~.

Inline `*not bold*` and `_not underlined_` stay literal.

Words like some_variable_name, and/or and 2*3*4 are left alone,
and https://example.com/a/b keeps its slashes.

See [the site](https://example.com) or <https://example.com>.

Linked notes: [[other|the other note]] and [[#Markup]].
